what: The photo unfolds from a center point with a circular mask — radial-gradient(closest-side) mask size 0 → 100% over .6s cubic-bezier(.7,.16,.27,.85). The mask remains after fully unfolding, so the photo stays rounded. It triggers once when it enters the band from beyond the top 33% to within the bottom 33% of the screen (rootMargin 33% 0 -33%). The second photo is delayed by .1s

options.band: Screen ratio (%) trimmed from top and bottom, default 33 — opens when the screen’s top edge touches the 67% line
options.loop: If on, it folds back in .3s when leaving the band (default: once)

from.where: index.html .rp-msg__img (two round photos for the president’s greeting — original data-anime="mask-circle", second data-anime-delay 0.1). A full site does the same job with shared.css [data-anime] + shared.js observer
